	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra List.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping HeapCorrespondence.

Require Import Effects.

Require Import HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed.

Require Import FreeItems.

Require Import Initialization InitTyping CommittedSubHeap.

Require Import FreeSubHeapSingle.

Require Import EffectCorrespondence FreeSubHeapStack StackTyping InertInitContexts.

Inductive ty_config :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> list eff_ctx -> list effects -> config -> typ -> Prop :=

| ty_config_c : forall Gamma Delta Sigma ℰ ℰs Fs t T i U effs' effs effss,
    inert Gamma ->
    inert_inits Delta ->
    heap_correspond Gamma Sigma ->
    free_sub_heaps Gamma Delta Sigma (ℰ :: ℰs) ->
    ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs) Fs T i (effs :: effss)%list U ->
    Gamma ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    ⊢e t ∶ effs' ->
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i t ∶ i ->
    eff_ctx_corr (ℰ :: ℰs) ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list ->
    ty_config Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs) ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list (t; Fs; Sigma) U.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax PreTyping Typing GeneralTyping.

Require Import Effects Initialization InitTyping.

Inductive ty_stack :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> list eff_ctx -> stack ->
  typ -> init_typ -> list effects -> typ -> Prop :=

  | ty_stack_nil : forall Gamma Delta T U ℰ i,
      Gamma ⊢ T <: U ->
              ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: nil)
                       nil T i
                       (nil :: nil)%list U

  | ty_stack_let : forall L Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs t S i i' T effs effss effs' U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T i'
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> Gamma & x ~ S ⊢ open x t ∶ T) ->
      (forall x,
          x \notin L ->
          Gamma & x ~ S ⸴ Delta & x ~ i ⸴ dom ℰ \u \{ x} ⊢i open x t ∶ i') ->
      (forall x, x \notin L -> ⊢e open x t ∶ effs') ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_let t :: Fs)%list S i
               ((effs' ++ effs) :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_free : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effs effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               Fs T free
               (effs :: effss) U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->
      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (effs :: effss)%list U

  | ty_stack_ret_committed : forall Gamma Delta ℰ ℰs Fs x S i effss T U,
      ty_stack Gamma Delta ℰs
               Fs T committed
               effss U ->
      Gamma ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T ->

      Gamma ⸴ Delta ⸴ (dom ℰ) ⊢i trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ free ->
      ty_stack Gamma Delta (ℰ :: ℰs)
               (frame_ret x :: Fs)%list S i
               (nil :: effss)%list U.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax HeapUpdate.

Reserved Notation "t1 ↦ t2" (at level 40, t2 at level 39).

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_sel : forall x a Sigma y T hds fs,
    binds x (item_obj T hds) Sigma ->
    labels_has hds (heap_def_trm a (Some y)) ->
    (trm_sel (avar_f x) a; fs ; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f y); fs ; Sigma)

| red_asn : forall x a Sigma y Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma x a y Sigma' ->
    (trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y); fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f y); fs; Sigma')

| red_app : forall f a Sigma T t fs,
    binds f (item_lit (lit_fun T t)) Sigma ->
    (trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f a); fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (open a t; fs; Sigma)

| red_let_lit : forall T l t Sigma x fs,
    x # Sigma ->
    (trm_lit T l t ; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (open x t ; fs; Sigma & x ~ (item_lit l))

| red_new : forall Ts is' T ds t Sigma x c ys avs fs,
    x # Sigma ->
    x \notin fv (open_rec_vars 1 ys ds) ->
    binds c (item_lit (lit_con Ts is' T ds t)) Sigma ->
    length ys = length_s Ts ->
    vars_of_avars ys avs ->
    (trm_new (avar_f c) avs; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ ((open_vars (cons x ys) t)
           ; (frame_ret x :: fs)%list
           ; Sigma & x ~ (item_obj
                        (open_rec_vars 1 ys T)
                        (open_vars (cons x ys) (heap_defs_of_defs ds))))

| red_return : forall Sigma x y fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f y); (frame_ret x :: fs)%list; Sigma)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f x); fs; Sigma)

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (frame_let t :: fs)%list; Sigma)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma)

| red_let_sta : forall T s t fs Sigma,
    (trm_let T s t; fs; Sigma)
      ↦ (s; (frame_let t :: fs)%list; Sigma)

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); nil; Sigma).
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Inductive defs_update : heap_defs -> trm_label -> var -> heap_defs -> Prop :=

| defs_update_var : forall hds a o x,
    defs_update (cons (heap_def_trm a o) hds)
                a x
                (cons (heap_def_trm a (Some x)) hds)
| defs_update_push : forall hds d a x hds',
    defs_update hds a x hds' ->
    defs_update (cons d hds) a x (cons d hds').

Definition heap_update (Sigma : heap) (x : var) (a : trm_label) (y : var) (Sigma' : heap) :=
  exists T hds hds' Sigma1 Sigma2,
    (Sigma = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds) & Sigma2) /\
    (x # Sigma2) /\
    (defs_update hds a y hds') /\
    (Sigma' = Sigma1 & x ~ (item_obj T hds') & Sigma2).
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax.

Definition inert_inits Delta :=
  forall x init, binds x init Delta ->
            init = free \/ init = committed.
Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax Typing PreTyping.

Require Import GeneralTyping RecordTypes InertTypes DefRecordInertTyping PreciseTyping.

Require Import SubstitutionClass Substitution Weakening Narrowing BndIntro.

Inductive ty_heap_def : DecTyping heap_def :=

| ty_heap_def_typ : forall Gamma A T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_typ A T ∶d dec_typ A T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_none : forall Gamma a T,
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a None ∶d dec_trm a T T

| ty_heap_def_trm_some : forall Gamma a x T,
    Gamma ⊢ (trm_var (avar_f x)) ∶ T ->
    Gamma ⊢ heap_def_trm a (Some x) ∶d dec_trm a T T.

Existing Instance ty_heap_def.

Inductive ty_item_s : ctx -> heap -> var -> Prop :=
| ty_item_lit_s : forall Gamma Sigma x l T,
    binds x T Gamma ->
    binds x (item_lit l) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x
| ty_item_obj_s : forall Gamma Sigma x U hds,
    binds x (typ_bnd U) Gamma ->
    binds x (item_obj U hds) Sigma ->
    Gamma ⊢ hds ∶ open x U ->
    ty_item_s Gamma Sigma x.

Definition heap_correspond (G : ctx) (Sigma : heap) : Prop :=
  (dom G = dom Sigma) /\
  (forall x,
      x \in dom G ->
      ty_item_s G Sigma x).
Set Implicit Arguments.

Context {A : Set}.

Class DecTypingRecord `(DecTyping A) :=

End DecTypingRecord.

Context {A : Set} `{LA : LabelOf A} `{DTA : DecTyping A}.

Context {DTL : DecTypingLabels DTA}.

Context {DTR : DecTypingRecord DTA}.

| committed_heap_def_typ : forall Delta A T,

    binds x committed Delta ->
    committed_heap_def Delta (heap_def_trm a (Some x)).

Inductive committed_heap_defs : init_ctx -> heap_defs -> Prop :=
| committed_heap_defs_nil : forall Delta,
    committed_heap_defs Delta nil

| committed_heap_defs_cons : forall Delta hd hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_def Delta hd ->
    committed_heap_defs Delta (cons hd hds).

Inductive committed_heap_item :
  ctx -> init_ctx -> item -> Prop :=

| committed_heap_lit : forall Gamma Delta l,
    Gamma ⸴ Delta ⊢c l ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_lit l)

| committed_heap_obj : forall Gamma Delta T hds,
    committed_heap_defs Delta hds ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta (item_obj T hds).

Definition well_committed_heap (Gamma : ctx) (Delta : init_ctx) (Sigma : heap) :=
  dom Gamma = dom Delta /\
  dom Delta = dom Sigma /\
  forall x itm,
    binds x committed Delta ->
    binds x itm Sigma ->
    committed_heap_item Gamma Delta itm.

Definition more_committed Delta Delta' :=
  (forall x, binds x committed Delta -> binds x committed Delta').

| subenv_empty : empty ⪯ empty
| subenv_grow: forall G G' x T T',

    ok (G & x ~ T) ->
    G ⊢ T <: T' ->
    G & x ~ T ⪯ G' & x ~ T'

Inductive init_typ : Set :=
  | committed : init_typ
  | free : init_typ
  | unspecified : init_typ.

Notation inits := (list init_typ).

Notation init_ctx := (env init_typ).

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_top  : typ
  | typ_bot  : typ
  | typ_rcd  : dec -> typ
  | typ_and  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_sel  : avar -> typ_label -> typ
  | typ_bnd  : typ -> typ
  | typ_all  : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> typ

with typs : Set :=
  | typs_nil : typs
  | typs_cons : typ -> typs -> typs

with dec : Set :=
  | dec_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> typ -> dec
  | dec_trm  : trm_label -> typ -> typ -> dec.

Scheme typ_mut  := Induction for typ Sort Prop
with   typs_mut := Induction for typs Sort Prop
with   dec_mut  := Induction for dec Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme typ_mutind from typ_mut, typs_mut, dec_mut.

Fixpoint typs_to_list (Ts : typs) : list typ :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => nil
  | typs_cons T Ts' => (T :: typs_to_list Ts')%list
  end.

Instance TypsToList : ToList typ typs := typs_to_list.

Arguments TypsToList _ /.

Fixpoint typs_of_list (xs : list typ) : typs :=
  match xs with
  | nil => typs_nil
  | (T :: Ts')%list => typs_cons T (typs_of_list Ts')
  end.

Instance TypsOfList : OfList typ typs := typs_of_list.

Arguments TypsOfList _ /.

Fixpoint open_rec_typ (k: nat) (u: var) (T: typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (open_rec_dec k u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ k u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (open_rec k u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (open_rec_typ (S k) u T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (open_rec_typ k u T1)
                             (open_rec_typ (S k) u T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T =>
    typ_con
      (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec_typ (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)

  end with
open_rec_typs (k : nat) (u : var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (open_rec_typ k u T)
              (open_rec_typs k u Ts)
  end with
open_rec_dec (k: nat) (u: var) (D: dec): dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (open_rec_typ k u T)
                            (open_rec_typ k u U)
  end.

Instance TypOpenable : Openable typ := open_rec_typ.

Instance TypsOpenable : Openable typs := open_rec_typs.

Instance DecOpenable : Openable dec := open_rec_dec.

Fixpoint fv_typ (T: typ) : vars :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => \{}
  | typ_bot        => \{}
  | typ_rcd D      => (fv_dec D)
  | typ_and T U    => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (fv x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (fv_typ T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => (fv_typ T1) \u (fv_typ T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => (fv_typs Ts) \u (fv_typ T)
  end with
fv_typs (Ts : typs) : vars :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => \{}
  | typs_cons T Ts => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typs Ts)
  end with
fv_dec (D: dec) : vars :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  | dec_trm m T U => (fv_typ T) \u (fv_typ U)
  end.

Instance TypFreeVar : FreeVar typ := fv_typ.

Instance TypsFreeVar : FreeVar typs := fv_typs.

Instance DecFreeVar : FreeVar dec := fv_dec.

Fixpoint subst_typ (z: var) (u: var) (T: typ) { struct T } : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (subst_dec z u D)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (subst_typ z u T1) (subst_typ z u T2)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (subst_var z u x) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (subst_typ z u T)
  | typ_all T U    => typ_all (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => typ_con (subst_typs z u Ts) is' (subst_typ z u T)
  end with
subst_typs (z: var) (u: var) (Ts: typs) { struct Ts } : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts => typs_cons (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typs z u Ts)
  end with
subst_dec (z: var) (u: var) (D: dec) { struct D } : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  | dec_trm L T U => dec_trm L (subst_typ z u T) (subst_typ z u U)
  end.

Instance TypSubstVar : SubstVar typ := subst_typ.

Instance TypsSubstVar : SubstVar typs := subst_typs.

Instance DecSubstVar : SubstVar dec := subst_dec.

Instance TypAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypOpenable TypFreeVar TypSubstVar := {}.

Instance TypsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TypsOpenable TypsFreeVar TypsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DecOpenable DecFreeVar DecSubstVar := {}.

Instance DecLabelOf : LabelOf dec :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | dec_typ L _ _ => label_typ L
      | dec_trm m _ _ => label_trm m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_typ {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (T: typ) : C :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => df
  | typ_bot        => df
  | typ_rcd D      => (collect_dec df f comb D)
  | typ_and T U    => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | typ_sel x L    => (f x)
  | typ_bnd T      => (collect_typ df f comb T)
  | typ_all T1 T2  => comb (collect_typ df f comb T1) (collect_typ df f comb T2)
  | typ_con Ts is' T => comb (collect_typs df f comb Ts) (collect_typ df f comb T)
  end with
collect_typs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (Ts: typs) : C :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => df
  | typs_cons T Ts => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typs df f comb Ts)
  end with
collect_dec {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (D: dec) : C :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  | dec_trm m T U => comb (collect_typ df f comb T) (collect_typ df f comb U)
  end.

Instance TypCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax
  := @collect_typ.

Instance TypsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TypsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_typs.

Instance DecCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_dec.

Fixpoint transform_typ (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (T : typ) (n : nat) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top        => typ_top
  | typ_bot        => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D      => typ_rcd (transform_dec f D n)
  | typ_and T1 T2  => typ_and (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 n)
  | typ_sel x L    => typ_sel (f x n) L
  | typ_bnd T      => typ_bnd (transform_typ f T (S n))
  | typ_all T1 T2  => typ_all (transform_typ f T1 n) (transform_typ f T2 (S n))
  | typ_con Ts is' T   => typ_con
                       (transform_typs f Ts n) is'
                       (transform_typ f T (S (length_s Ts) + n))
  end with
transform_typs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (Ts : typs) (n : nat) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts =>
    typs_cons (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typs f Ts n)
  end with
transform_dec (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (D : dec) (n : nat) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ L T U => dec_typ L (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  | dec_trm m T U => dec_trm m (transform_typ f T n) (transform_typ f U n)
  end.

Instance TypTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typ.

Instance TypsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TypsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_typs.

Instance DecTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DecAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_dec.

Inductive heap_def : Set :=
  | heap_def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> heap_def
  | heap_def_trm  : trm_label -> option var -> heap_def.

Notation heap_defs := (list heap_def).

Inductive item : Set :=
  | item_obj : typ -> heap_defs -> item
  | item_lit : lit -> item.

Definition heap_def_of_def (d : def) : heap_def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ A T => heap_def_typ A T
  | def_trm a   => heap_def_trm a None
  end.

Definition heap_defs_of_defs (ds : defs) : heap_defs :=
  List.map heap_def_of_def ds.

Instance HeapDefLabelOf : LabelOf heap_def | 1 :=
  fun hd =>
      match hd with
      | heap_def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | heap_def_trm m _ => label_trm m
      end.

Definition fv_heap_def (hd: heap_def) : vars :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ _ T        => (fv T)
  | heap_def_trm _ None     => \{}
  | heap_def_trm _ (Some x) => \{ x}
  end.

Instance HeapDefFreeVar : FreeVar heap_def := fv_heap_def.

Fixpoint open_rec_heap_def (k: nat) (u: var) (hd: heap_def)
         {struct hd} : heap_def :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ L T     => heap_def_typ L (open_rec k u T)
  | heap_def_trm m opt_x => heap_def_trm m opt_x
  end.

Instance HeapDefOpenable : Openable heap_def := open_rec_heap_def.

Definition fv_item (v: item) : vars :=
  match v with
  | item_obj T hds    => (fv T) \u (fv hds)
  | item_lit l => (fv l)
  end.

Instance ItemFreeVar : FreeVar item := fv_item.

Definition subst_heap_def (z: var) (u: var) (hd: heap_def)
  : heap_def :=
  match hd with
  | heap_def_typ l t        => heap_def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | heap_def_trm l None     => heap_def_trm l None
  | heap_def_trm l (Some x) =>
    heap_def_trm l (Some (subst_fvar z u x))
  end.

Instance HeapDefSubstVar : SubstVar heap_def := subst_heap_def.

Instance HeapDefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax HeapDefOpenable HeapDefFreeVar HeapDefSubstVar := {}.

Definition open_rec_item (n: nat) (x: var) (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj T ds    => item_obj (open_rec n x T)
                              (open_rec (S n) x ds)
  | item_lit l => item_lit (open_rec n x l)
  end.

Instance ItemOpenable : Openable item := open_rec_item.

Definition subst_item x y (v: item) : item :=
  match v with
  | item_obj T ds    => item_obj (subst_var x y T) (subst_var x y ds)
  | item_lit l => item_lit (subst_var x y l)
  end.

Instance ItemSubstVar : SubstVar item := subst_item.

Instance ItemAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax ItemOpenable ItemFreeVar ItemSubstVar := {}.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Inductive def : Set :=
  | def_typ  : typ_label -> typ -> def
  | def_trm  : trm_label -> def.

Notation defs := (list def).

Inductive trm : Set :=
  | trm_var  : avar -> trm
  | trm_sel  : avar -> trm_label -> trm
  | trm_app  : avar -> avar -> trm
  | trm_let  : typ -> trm -> trm -> trm
  | trm_lit  : typ -> lit -> trm -> trm
  | trm_asn  : avar -> trm_label -> avar -> trm
  | trm_new  : avar -> list avar -> trm
with lit : Set :=
  | lit_fun : typ -> trm -> lit
  | lit_con  : typs -> inits -> typ -> defs -> trm -> lit.

Scheme trm_mut  := Induction for trm  Sort Prop
with   lit_mut  := Induction for lit  Sort Prop.

Combined Scheme trm_mutind from trm_mut, lit_mut.

Definition open_rec_def (k: nat) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (open_rec k u T)
  | def_trm m   => def_trm m
  end.

Instance DefOpenable : Openable def := open_rec_def.

Fixpoint open_rec_trm (k: nat) (u: var) (t: trm): trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_sel v m    => trm_sel (open_rec k u v) m
  | trm_app f a    => trm_app (open_rec k u f) (open_rec k u a)
  | trm_let T t1 t2 =>
    trm_let (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm k u t1) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t2)
  | trm_lit T l t =>
    trm_lit (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_lit k u l) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | trm_asn v m v2 => trm_asn (open_rec k u v) m (open_rec k u v2)
  | trm_new a avs  => trm_new (open_rec k u a) (open_rec k u avs)
  end with
open_rec_lit (k: nat) (u: var) (l: lit): lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (open_rec k u T) (open_rec_trm (S k) u t)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
    lit_con
      (open_rec k u Ts)
      is'
      (open_rec (S (length_s Ts) + k) u T)
      (open_rec (S (length_s Ts) + k) u ds)
      (open_rec_trm (S (length_s Ts) + k) u t)

  end.

Instance TrmOpenable : Openable trm := open_rec_trm.

Instance LitOpenable : Openable lit := open_rec_lit.

Definition fv_def (d: def) : vars :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (fv T)
  | def_trm _       => \{}
  end.

Instance DefFreeVar : FreeVar def := fv_def.

Fixpoint fv_trm (t: trm) : vars :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a         => (fv a)
  | trm_sel x m       => (fv x)
  | trm_app f a       => (fv f) \u (fv a)
  | trm_let T t1 t2   => (fv T) \u (fv_trm t1) \u (fv_trm t2)
  | trm_lit T l t     => (fv T) \u (fv_lit l) \u (fv_trm t)
  | trm_asn x m y     => (fv x) \u (fv y)
  | trm_new a avs     => (fv a) \u (fv avs)
  end with
fv_lit (l: lit) : vars :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e    => (fv T) \u (fv_trm e)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t => (fv Ts) \u (fv T) \u (fv ds) \u (fv_trm t)
  end.

Instance TrmFreeVar : FreeVar trm := fv_trm.

Instance LitFreeVar : FreeVar lit := fv_lit.

Definition subst_def (z: var) (u: var) (d: def) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ l t => def_typ l (subst_var z u t)
  | def_trm l   => def_trm l
  end.

Instance DefSubstVar : SubstVar def := subst_def.

Fixpoint subst_trm (z: var) (u: var) (t: trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var x        => trm_var (subst_var z u x)
  | trm_sel x1 L     => trm_sel (subst_var z u x1) L
  | trm_app x1 x2    => trm_app (subst_var z u x1) (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_let T t1 t2  =>
    trm_let (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t1) (subst_trm z u t2)
  | trm_lit T l t    =>
    trm_lit (subst_var z u T) (subst_lit z u l) (subst_trm z u t)
  | trm_asn x1 L x2  => trm_asn (subst_var z u x1) L (subst_var z u x2)
  | trm_new x xs     =>
    trm_new (subst_var z u x) (subst_var z u xs)
  end with
subst_lit (z: var) (u: var) (l: lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t   => lit_fun (subst_var z u T) (subst_trm z u t)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
    lit_con (subst_var z u Ts)
            is'
            (subst_var z u T)
            (subst_var z u ds)
            (subst_trm z u t)
  end.

Instance TrmSubstVar : SubstVar trm := subst_trm.

Instance LitSubstVar : SubstVar lit := subst_lit.

Instance TrmAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TrmOpenable TrmFreeVar TrmSubstVar := {}.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_trm m   => label_trm m
      end.

Definition collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_trm _       => df
  end.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a        => (f a)
  | trm_sel x m      => (f x)
  | trm_app f' a     => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let T t1 t2  =>
    comb (collect df f comb T)
         (comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2))
  | trm_lit T l t    =>
    comb (collect df f comb T)
         (comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t))
  | trm_asn x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_new a avs    => comb (f a) (collect df f comb avs)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
    comb (collect df f comb Ts)
         (comb (collect df f comb T)
               (comb (collect df f comb ds) (collect_trm df f comb t)))
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Definition transform_def (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (d : def) (n : nat) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (transform f T n)
  | def_trm m   => def_trm m
  end.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_sel v m    => trm_sel (f v n) m
  | trm_app f' a    => trm_app (f f' n) (f a n)
  | trm_let T t1 t2 =>
    trm_let (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t1 n) (transform_trm f t2 (S n))
  | trm_lit T l t  =>
    trm_lit (transform f T n) (transform_lit f l n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | trm_asn v m v2 => trm_asn (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  | trm_new a avs  => trm_new (f a n) (transform f avs n)
  end with
transform_lit (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (l : lit) (n : nat) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
    lit_con
      (transform f Ts n)
      is'
      (transform f T (S (length_s Ts) + n))
      (transform f ds (S (length_s Ts) + n))
      (transform_trm f t (S (length_s Ts) + n))

  end.

Instance TrmTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_trm.

Instance LitTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_lit.

Declare Scope syntax_scope.

Delimit Scope syntax_scope with S.

Open Scope syntax_scope.

Class Openable (A : Type) := open_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Class FreeVar (A : Type) := fv : A -> vars.

Class SubstVar (A : Type) := subst_var : var -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Openable FreeVar SubstVar.

Arguments open_rec _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments fv _ _ !_ /.

Arguments subst_var _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class AbstractSyntax (A : Type) `(Openable A) `(FreeVar A) `(SubstVar A).

Notation "z '/[' x '->' y ']'"
  := (subst_var x y z) (x at level 69, at level 70) : syntax_scope.

Notation subst_vars := (vars_zip_map subst_var).

Notation "z '/[' xs '-->' ys ']'"
  := (subst_vars xs ys z) (xs at level 69, at level 70) : syntax_scope.

Notation open := (open_rec 0).

Definition open_depth_rec `{AS : Openable A} n x a d
  := open_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation open_depth := (open_depth_rec 0).

Arguments open_depth_rec _ _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Definition closed `{AS: Openable A} a
  := forall n x, open_rec n x a = a.

Fixpoint open_rec_vars `{AS : Openable A} (k: nat) (ys: list var) (X: A): A :=
  match ys with
  | nil => X
  | cons y ys => open_rec_vars (S k) ys (open_rec k y X)
  end.

Notation open_vars := (open_rec_vars 0).

Arguments open_rec_vars _ _ _ !_ _ /.

Class DecideFv `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) := dec_fv : var -> A -> bool.

Arguments dec_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition dec_notin_fv `{DFv: DecideFv A} x a := negb (dec_fv x a).

Arguments dec_notin_fv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ReflectFv `(DFv: DecideFv A) :=
  reflect_fv : forall x a,
    (x \in fv a) <-> (dec_fv x a) = true.

Class Closing `(AS: AbstractSyntax A) :=
  close_rec : nat -> var -> A -> A.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with Closing.

Notation close := (close_rec 0).

Arguments close_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition close_depth_rec `{Cl : Closing A} n x a d
  := close_rec (n + d) x a.

Notation close_depth := (close_depth_rec 0).

Arguments close_depth_rec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Parameter typ_label: Set.

Parameter trm_label: Set.

Inductive label: Set :=
| label_typ: typ_label -> label
| label_trm: trm_label -> label.

Class LabelOf (A : Type) := label_of : A -> label.

Arguments label_of _ _ !_ /.

Class GetLabeled (B A : Type) `(LabelOf B) :=
  get_labeld : label -> A -> option B.

Arguments get_labeld _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Definition labels_has `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (d: B) :=
  get_labeld (label_of d) ds = Some d.

Definition labels_hasnt `{GetLabeled B A} (ds: A) (l: label) :=
  get_labeld l ds = None.

Class SubstLabel `(SubstVar A) `(LabelOf A) :=
  subst_label: forall x y d,
    label_of (subst_var x y d) = label_of d.

Class OpenTwice `(AS: Openable A) :=
  open_twice : forall n x y,
    (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n x).

Class OpenCommut `(AS: Openable A) :=
    open_commut : forall m n x y,
        m <> n ->
        (open_rec m x) ∘ (open_rec n y) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (open_rec m x).

Class SubstFresh `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_fresh : forall x y X,
    x \notin fv X -> subst_var x y X = X.

Class SubstOpenCommut `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  subst_open_commut : forall x y z X n,
    subst_var x y (open_rec n z X)
    = open_rec n (z \[x -> y]) (subst_var x y X).

Class FvOpenCases `(AS : AbstractSyntax A) :=
  fv_open_cases : forall x a n,
    fv (open_rec n x a) = fv a \/
    fv (open_rec n x a) = \{ x} \u fv a.

Class OpenClose `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  open_close : forall n x,
    (open_rec n x) ∘ (close_rec n x) = open_rec n x.

Class CloseOpen `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  close_open : forall n x,
    (close_rec n x) ∘ (open_rec n x) = close_rec n x.

Class SubstOpenClose `(Cl: Closing A) :=
  subst_open_close : forall n x y,
    (subst_var x y) ∘ (open_rec n x) = (open_rec n y) ∘ (close_rec n x).

Class CloseUnbound `(Cl: Closing) :=
  close_unbound : forall x a n,
    x \notin fv a ->
    close_rec n x a = a.

Class OpenInjective `(AS : AbstractSyntax) :=
  open_fresh_injective : forall (X Y : A) k z,
    z \notin fv X ->
    z \notin fv Y ->
    open_rec k z X = open_rec k z Y ->
    X = Y.

Class SubstIntro `(AS : AbstractSyntax) :=
  subst_intro : forall x y n X,
    x \notin (fv X) ->
    open_rec n y X = subst_var x y (open_rec n x X).

Class ClosingInner
      `{AS: AbstractSyntax A}
      {DFv: DecideFv AS} (DFvS: ReflectFv DFv)
      (C: Closing AS) :=
  close_inner : forall n x,
    close_depth_rec n x
    = (dec_apply (dec_notin_fv x) (ignore_second id) (close_depth_rec n x)).

Class SubstitutionInner
      `{AS: AbstractSyntax A}
      {DFv: DecideFv AS} (DFvS: ReflectFv DFv) :=
  subst_inner : forall {B : Type} x y,
    (ignore_second (B:=B) (subst_var x y))
    = (dec_apply (dec_notin_fv x) (ignore_second id) (ignore_second (subst_var x y))).

Class ToList (B A : Type) :=
  to_list : A -> list B.

Arguments to_list _ _ _ !_ /.

Class OfList (B A : Type) :=
  of_list : list B -> A.

Arguments of_list _ _ _ !_ /.

Class ListLike {B A : Type} `(ToList B A) `(OfList B A) :=
  { to_list_of_list : forall x, (of_list (to_list x)) = x;
    of_list_to_list : forall l, (to_list (of_list l)) = l;
  }.

Bind Scope syntax_scope with ToList OfList.

Notation fv_env := (fv_in_values fv).

Notation subst_env x y := (map (subst_var x y)).

Notation subst_env_vars xs ys := (map (subst_vars xs ys)).

Instance VarsSubstVar : SubstVar vars :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (vs: vars) =>
    If x \in vs then (vs \- \{x}) \u \{y} else vs.

Section Open_depth.

Context `{AS: AbstractSyntax A}.

End Open_depth.

Section Subst_depth.

Context `{AS: AbstractSyntax A}.

End Subst_depth.

End Close_depth.

Section Fv_env.

End About_OpenTwice.

End OpenClose.

Section CloseOpen.

Section SubstOpenClose.

End SubstOpenClose.

End About_ClosingSanity.

Section About_ListLike.

Context `{ListLike B A}.

Definition app_s xs ys := of_list ((to_list xs) ++ (to_list ys)).

Infix "++" := app_s (right associativity, at level 60).

Definition map_f f x := of_list (List.map f (to_list x)).

Definition length_s xs := length (to_list xs).

End About_ListLike.

Arguments length_s _ _ _ !_ /.

Arguments map_f _ _ _ _ _ !_ /.

Context `{AS: AbstractSyntax A}.

Context {C: Closing AS}.

Context {CU: CloseUnbound C}.

Context {CO: CloseOpen C}.

Context {SOC: SubstOpenClose C}.

End About_CloseUnbound.

Section ListOfSyntax.

Context {A: Type}.

Section GetLabeled.

Context {L: LabelOf A}.

Fixpoint get_labeld_list (l: label) (ds: list A): option A :=
      match ds with
      | nil => None
      | cons d ds =>
        If label_of d = l then Some d else get_labeld_list l ds
    end.

Instance ListGetLabeled : GetLabeled (list A) L :=
      get_labeld_list.

End GetLabeled.

Context {O: Openable A}.

Context {F: FreeVar A}.

Context {S: SubstVar A}.

Context {AS: AbstractSyntax O F S}.

Definition open_rec_list : Openable (list A) :=
    (fun n x => List.map (open_rec n x)).

Definition fv_list : FreeVar (list A) :=
    (List.fold_right (fun a acc => union (fv a) acc) \{}).

Definition subst_var_list : SubstVar (list A) :=
    (fun x y => List.map (subst_var x y)).

Arguments open_rec_list /.

Arguments fv_list /.

Arguments subst_var_list /.

Instance ListOpenable : Openable (list A) := open_rec_list.

Instance ListFreeVar : FreeVar (list A) := fv_list.

Instance ListSubstVar : SubstVar (list A) := subst_var_list.

Instance ListAbstractSyntax : AbstractSyntax ListOpenable ListFreeVar ListSubstVar := {}.

Section LabelHasnt.

Context {L: LabelOf A}.

Context {SL: SubstLabel S L}.

Existing Instance ListGetLabeled.

End LabelHasnt.

Section OpenCompose.

Context {OT: OpenTwice O}.

Context {OC: OpenCommut O}.

End OpenCompose.

Section SubstFresh.

Context {SF: SubstFresh AS}.

End SubstFresh.

Section SubstOpenCommut.

Context {SF: SubstOpenCommut AS}.

End SubstOpenCommut.

Context {FOC: FvOpenCases AS}.

End FvOpenCases.

Context {C: Closing AS}.

Instance ListClosing : Closing ListAbstractSyntax :=
      (fun n x => List.map (close_rec n x)).

Context {OC: OpenClose C}.

Context {CO: CloseOpen C}.

Context {SOC: SubstOpenClose C}.

Context {CU: CloseUnbound C}.

End Closing.

End ListOfSyntax.

Arguments ListFreeVar _ _ _ /.

Arguments ListSubstVar _ _ _ /.

Existing Instance ListOpenable | 1.

Existing Instance ListFreeVar | 1.

Existing Instance ListSubstVar | 1.

Existing Instance ListAbstractSyntax | 1.

Existing Instance ListClosing | 1.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Inductive avar : Set :=
  | avar_b : nat -> avar
  | avar_f : var -> avar.

Notation avars := (list avar).

Instance AvarOpenable : Openable avar :=
  fun n x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => If n = i then avar_f x else avar_b i
    | avar_f y => avar_f y
    end.

Instance AvarFreeVar : FreeVar avar :=
  fun a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => \{}
    | avar_f x => \{x}
    end.

Instance AvarSubstVar : SubstVar avar :=
  fun (x: var) (y: var) (a: avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f z => (avar_f (If z = x then y else z))
    end.

Instance AvarAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax AvarOpenable AvarFreeVar AvarSubstVar := {}.

Instance AvarDecideFv : DecideFv AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun x a =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => false
    | avar_f y => (If x = y then true else false)
    end.

Instance AvarClosing : Closing AvarAbstractSyntax :=
  fun (n : nat) (x : var) (a : avar) =>
    match a with
    | avar_b i => avar_b i
    | avar_f y => (If y = x then avar_b n else avar_f y)
    end.

Inductive vars_of_avars : list var -> list avar -> Prop :=
| vars_of_avars_nil : vars_of_avars nil nil
| vars_of_avars_cons : forall x vs avs,
    vars_of_avars vs avs ->
    vars_of_avars (cons x vs) (cons (avar_f x) avs).

Require Import TransformCollect.

Instance AvarsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun {C} df f comb => List.fold_right (fun a acc => comb (f a) acc) df.

Instance AvarsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax ListAbstractSyntax :=
  fun f a n => List.map (fun b => (f b n)) a.

From Stdlib Require Import Program.Equality List Lia.
Require Import StackTyping HeapUpdate HeapCorrespondence InitLookup InertInitContexts
  EffectCorrespondence HeapEffects HeapDefsPointsTo WellPointed FreeItems
  CommittedSubHeap FreeSubHeapSingle FreeSubHeapStack.

Local Lemma inert_binding : forall G x T,
  inert G -> binds x T G -> inert_typ T.
Proof.
  intros G x T H. induction H; intro Hb.
  - false (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - rewrite binds_concat in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [_ Hb]].
    + apply binds_single_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [? ->]. assumption.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma open_record : forall R ls,
  record_typ R ls -> forall n x, record_typ (open_rec n x R) ls.
Proof.
  intros R ls H. induction H; intros n x; subst l.
  - destruct H; constructor; [constructor|reflexivity].
  - destruct H0; econstructor; try solve [eauto | constructor].
Qed.

Local Lemma opened_record : forall R ls n x,
  record_typ (open_rec n x R) ls -> record_typ R ls.
Proof.
  induction R; intros ls n x H; inversion H; subst.
  - destruct d; inversion H1; subst;
      constructor; [constructor; congruence | reflexivity].
  - destruct R2; try discriminate.
    destruct d; inversion H6; subst;
      econstructor; try solve [eapply IHR1; eassumption | constructor; congruence |
                               reflexivity | eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma record_leaf : forall R ls D,
  record_typ R ls -> record_has R D -> record_dec D /\\ label_of D \\in ls.
Proof.
  intros R ls D Hr. induction Hr; intros H; inversion H; subst.
  - split; auto. apply in_singleton_self.
  - destruct (IHHr H3); split; auto. apply in_union_l; assumption.
  - inversion H3; subst. split; auto. apply in_union_r, in_singleton_self.
Qed.

Local Lemma record_unique : forall R ls D E,
  record_typ R ls -> record_has R D -> record_has R E ->
  label_of D = label_of E -> D = E.
Proof.
  intros R ls D E Hr. induction Hr; intros HD HE Eq;
    inversion HD; inversion HE; subst.
  - reflexivity.
  - eauto.
  - match goal with
    | H : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst
    end.
    exfalso. eapply H2. rewrite <- Eq. eapply (proj2 (record_leaf Hr _)); eauto.
  - match goal with
    | H : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst
    end.
    exfalso. eapply H2. rewrite Eq. eapply (proj2 (record_leaf Hr _)); eauto.
  - repeat match goal with H : record_has (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H end.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Definition exact_member (G : ctx) x A T :=
  exists R, binds x (typ_bnd R) G /\\ record_has (open x R) (dec_typ A T T).

Local Lemma exact_member_unique : forall G x A S T,
  inert G -> exact_member G x A S -> exact_member G x A T -> S = T.
Proof.
  intros G x A S T Hi [R [Hb Hs]] [R' [Hb' Ht]].
  assert (typ_bnd R = typ_bnd R') by (eapply binds_func; eauto).
  injection H as <-.
  pose proof (inert_binding Hi Hb) as H. inversion H as [| |? [ls Hr]]; subst.
  pose proof (record_unique (open_record Hr 0 x) Hs Ht eq_refl) as E.
  congruence.
Qed.

Local Lemma record_project : forall G R D,
  record_has R D -> G ⊢ R <: typ_rcd D.
Proof.
  intros G R D H. induction H; eauto using subtyp_refl, subtyp_trans,
    subtyp_and11, subtyp_and12.
Qed.

Local Lemma exact_member_typing : forall G x A T,
  exact_member G x A T -> G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A T T).
Proof.
  intros G x A T [R [Hb Hr]].
  eapply ty_sub; [eapply ty_rec_elim, ty_var; exact Hb | apply record_project; exact Hr].
Qed.

(* Function subtyping is kept as a sequence of steps. Each step can be
   instantiated at the actual argument, including its dependent result. *)
Local Inductive function_flow (G : ctx) : typ -> typ -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| function_flow_refl : forall S T, function_flow G S T S T
| function_flow_step : forall L S T S' T',
    G ⊢ S' <: S ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> G & x ~ S' ⊢ open x T <: open x T') ->
    function_flow G S T S' T'
| function_flow_trans : forall S T S' T' S'' T'',
    function_flow G S T S' T' -> function_flow G S' T' S'' T'' ->
    function_flow G S T S'' T''.

Local Inductive exact_sub (G : ctx) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| es_top : forall T, exact_sub G T typ_top
| es_bot : forall T, exact_sub G typ_bot T
| es_refl : forall T, exact_sub G T T
| es_trans : forall S T U, exact_sub G S T -> exact_sub G T U -> exact_sub G S U
| es_and1 : forall T U, exact_sub G (typ_and T U) T
| es_and2 : forall T U, exact_sub G (typ_and T U) U
| es_and : forall S T U, exact_sub G S T -> exact_sub G S U ->
    exact_sub G S (typ_and T U)
| es_fld : forall a S1 S2 T1 T2, exact_sub G S2 S1 -> exact_sub G T1 T2 ->
    exact_sub G (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S1 T1)) (typ_rcd (dec_trm a S2 T2))
| es_typ : forall A S1 S2 T1 T2, exact_sub G S2 S1 -> exact_sub G T1 T2 ->
    exact_sub G (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2))
| es_sel1 : forall x A T, exact_member G x A T -> exact_sub G (typ_sel (avar_f x) A) T
| es_sel2 : forall x A T, exact_member G x A T -> exact_sub G T (typ_sel (avar_f x) A)
| es_all : forall L S T S' T',
    G ⊢ S' <: S ->
    (forall x, x \\notin L -> G & x ~ S' ⊢ open x T <: open x T') ->
    exact_sub G (typ_all S T) (typ_all S' T').

Local Lemma exact_sub_general : forall G S T,
  exact_sub G S T -> G ⊢ S <: T.
Proof.
  intros G S T H. induction H; eauto using subtyp_top, subtyp_bot, subtyp_refl,
    subtyp_trans, subtyp_and11, subtyp_and12, subtyp_and2, subtyp_fld,
    subtyp_typ, subtyp_all, subtyp_sel1, subtyp_sel2, exact_member_typing.
Qed.

(* Head observations follow intersections and exact type aliases. The
   inductive definition also covers aliases that refer back to themselves. *)
Local Inductive head (G : ctx) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| head_bot : head G typ_bot typ_bot
| head_rcd : forall D, head G (typ_rcd D) (typ_rcd D)
| head_all : forall S T, head G (typ_all S T) (typ_all S T)
| head_con : forall Ts is' T, head G (typ_con Ts is' T) (typ_con Ts is' T)
| head_bnd : forall T, head G (typ_bnd T) (typ_bnd T)
| head_and1 : forall S T A, head G S A -> head G (typ_and S T) A
| head_and2 : forall S T A, head G T A -> head G (typ_and S T) A
| head_sel : forall x A T B, exact_member G x A T ->
    head G T B -> head G (typ_sel (avar_f x) A) B.

Local Definition head_flow G S T : Prop :=
  match S, T with
  | typ_bot, _ => True
  | typ_rcd (dec_trm a S1 T1), typ_rcd (dec_trm b S2 T2) =>
      a = b /\\ exact_sub G S2 S1 /\\ exact_sub G T1 T2
  | typ_rcd (dec_typ a S1 T1), typ_rcd (dec_typ b S2 T2) =>
      a = b /\\ exact_sub G S2 S1 /\\ exact_sub G T1 T2
  | typ_all S1 T1, typ_all S2 T2 => function_flow G S1 T1 S2 T2
  | _, _ => S = T
  end.

Local Lemma head_flow_refl : forall G S, head_flow G S S.
Proof. intros G []; simpl; try destruct d; eauto using es_refl, function_flow_refl. Qed.

Local Lemma head_flow_trans : forall G S T U,
  head_flow G S T -> head_flow G T U -> head_flow G S U.
Proof.
  intros G S T U. destruct S, T, U; simpl; try destruct d; try destruct d0;
    try destruct d1; simpl; intros; try congruence;
    repeat match goal with H : _ /\\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
    eauto 8 using es_trans, function_flow_trans.
Qed.

Local Lemma exact_sub_heads : forall G S T,
  inert G -> exact_sub G S T -> forall B, head G T B ->
  exists A, head G S A /\\ head_flow G A B.
Proof.
  intros G S T Hi H. induction H; intros B Hb.
  - inversion Hb.
  - exists typ_bot. split; [constructor|exact I].
  - exists B. auto using head_flow_refl.
  - destruct (IHexact_sub2 _ Hb) as [A [Ha Hab]].
    destruct (IHexact_sub1 _ Ha) as [C [Hc Hca]].
    eauto using head_flow_trans.
  - exists B. auto using head_and1, head_flow_refl.
  - exists B. auto using head_and2, head_flow_refl.
  - inversion Hb; subst; auto.
  - inversion Hb; subst. eexists; split; [constructor|simpl; auto].
  - inversion Hb; subst. eexists; split; [constructor|simpl; auto].
  - exists B. auto using head_sel, head_flow_refl.
  - inversion Hb; subst. match goal with
    | Hm : exact_member G x A ?U, Ha : head G ?U B |- _ =>
      assert (T = U) by (eapply exact_member_unique; eauto); subst U;
      exists B; auto using head_flow_refl
    end.
  - inversion Hb; subst. eexists; split; [constructor|simpl; eauto using function_flow_step].
Qed.

Local Inductive observable : typ -> Prop :=
| obs_bot : observable typ_bot
| obs_rcd : forall D, observable (typ_rcd D)
| obs_all : forall S T, observable (typ_all S T)
| obs_con : forall Ts is' T, observable (typ_con Ts is' T).

Local Inductive observe (G : ctx) (x : var) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| observe_atom : forall T A, head G T A -> observable A -> observe G x T A
| observe_open : forall T R A, head G T (typ_bnd R) ->
    observe G x (open x R) A -> observe G x T A.

Local Lemma exact_sub_observe : forall G x S T,
  inert G -> exact_sub G S T -> forall B, observe G x T B ->
  exists A, observe G x S A /\\ head_flow G A B.
Proof.
  intros G x S T Hi H B Ho. destruct Ho.
  - destruct (exact_sub_heads Hi H H0) as [C [Hc Hcb]].
    exists C. split; auto. apply observe_atom; auto.
    destruct C; simpl in Hcb; try constructor; try destruct d; destruct A;
      simpl in Hcb; try destruct d; try discriminate; inversion Hcb; subst; auto.
  - destruct (exact_sub_heads Hi H H0) as [C [Hc Hcb]].
    destruct C; simpl in Hcb; try destruct d; try discriminate.
    + exists typ_bot. auto using observe_atom, obs_bot.
    + injection Hcb as ->. eauto using observe_open, head_flow_refl.
Qed.

Local Inductive binding_atom (x : var) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| ba_all : forall S T, binding_atom x (typ_all S T) (typ_all S T)
| ba_con : forall Ts is' T, binding_atom x (typ_con Ts is' T) (typ_con Ts is' T)

Local Lemma record_heads : forall G R ls A,
  record_typ R ls -> head G R A ->
  exists D, A = typ_rcd D /\\ record_has R D.
Proof.
  intros G R ls A Hr. revert A. induction Hr; intros B Hb; inversion Hb; subst.
  - eauto using rh_one.
  - destruct (IHHr _ H5) as [E [-> He]]. eauto using rh_andl.
  - match goal with H : head _ (typ_rcd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst end.
    eauto using rh_one, rh_andr.
Qed.

Local Lemma inert_observe : forall G x T A,
  inert_typ T -> observe G x T A -> binding_atom x T A.
Proof.
  intros G x T A Hi Ho. destruct Hi as [S T | Ts is' T Hr | R [ls Hr]];
    inversion Ho; subst;
    repeat match goal with H : head _ (typ_all _ _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
      | H : head _ (typ_con _ _ _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
      | H : head _ (typ_bnd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
      | H : observable (typ_bnd _) |- _ => inversion H
    end; try constructor.
  match goal with H : observe _ _ _ _ |- _ => destruct H end.
  - destruct (record_heads (open_record Hr 0 x) H) as [D [-> Hd]].
    constructor. exact Hd.
  - destruct (record_heads (open_record Hr 0 x) H) as [? [E _]]. discriminate E.
Qed.

Local Definition variable_shape G x T :=
  exists B, binds x B G /\\
  forall A, observe G x T A ->
  exists C, binding_atom x B C /\\ head_flow G C A.

Local Lemma variable_shape_and : forall G x S T,
  variable_shape G x S -> variable_shape G x T -> variable_shape G x (typ_and S T).
Proof.
  intros G x S T [B [Hb Hs]] [B' [Hb' Ht]].
  assert (B = B') by (eapply binds_func; eauto). subst B'.
  exists B. split; auto. intros A H. destruct H;
    match goal with Hh : head _ (typ_and _ _) _ |- _ => inversion Hh; subst end;
    eauto using observe_atom, observe_open.
Qed.

Local Lemma variable_shape_member : forall G x A S T,
  inert G -> variable_shape G x (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T)) ->
  exists V, exact_member G x A V /\\ exact_sub G S V /\\ exact_sub G V T.
Proof.
  intros G x A S T Hi [B [Hb H]].
  destruct (H _ (observe_atom x (head_rcd G _) (obs_rcd _))) as [C [Hc Hf]].
  inversion Hc; subst; simpl in Hf; try discriminate.
  destruct D; simpl in Hf; try discriminate.
  destruct Hf as [-> [Hs Ht]].
  pose proof (inert_binding Hi Hb) as Hit. inversion Hit as [| |? [ls Hr]]; subst.
  destruct (record_leaf (open_record Hr 0 x) H0) as [Hd _].
  inversion Hd; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma exact_typing :
  (forall G t T, G ⊢ t ∶ T -> inert G ->
      forall x, t = trm_var (avar_f x) -> variable_shape G x T) /\\
  (forall G l T, G ⊢ l ∶ T -> True) /\\
  (forall G S T, G ⊢ S <: T -> inert G -> exact_sub G S T) /\\
  (forall G vs Ts, G ⊢ vs :: Ts -> True).
Proof.
  apply rules_mutind; intros; try discriminate; try exact I.
  - match goal with H : trm_var _ = trm_var _ |- _ => inversion H; subst end.
    eexists; split; [eassumption|].
    intros. eauto using inert_observe, inert_binding, head_flow_refl.
  - subst. match goal with
    | IH : inert _ -> forall _, trm_var _ = _ -> variable_shape _ _ (open _ _) |- _ =>
      destruct (IH ltac:(assumption) _ eq_refl) as [B [Hb Hs]]
    end.
    exists B. split; auto. intros A Ho. destruct Ho;
      match goal with H : head _ (typ_bnd _) _ |- _ => inversion H; subst end;
      auto. match goal with H : observable (typ_bnd _) |- _ => inversion H end.
  - subst. match goal with
    | IH : inert _ -> forall _, trm_var _ = _ -> variable_shape _ _ (typ_bnd _) |- _ =>
      destruct (IH ltac:(assumption) _ eq_refl) as [B [Hb Hs]]
    end.
    exists B. split; auto. eauto using observe_open, head_bnd.
  - subst. eapply variable_shape_and; eauto.
  - subst. match goal with
    | IH : inert _ -> forall _, trm_var _ = _ -> variable_shape _ _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct (IH ltac:(assumption) _ eq_refl) as [B [Hb Hs]]
    end.
    exists B. split; auto. intros A Ho.
    destruct (exact_sub_observe x ltac:(assumption) ltac:(auto) Ho) as [C [Hc Hca]].
    destruct (Hs _ Hc) as [D [Hd Hdc]]. eauto using head_flow_trans.
  - apply es_top.
  - apply es_bot.
  - apply es_refl.
  - eauto using es_trans.
  - apply es_and1.
  - apply es_and2.
  - auto using es_and.
  - auto using es_fld.
  - auto using es_typ.
  - match goal with IH : inert _ -> forall _, trm_var _ = _ -> _ |- _ =>
      destruct (variable_shape_member ltac:(assumption) (IH ltac:(assumption) _ eq_refl))
        as [V [Hv [Hs Ht]]]
    end.
    eauto using es_trans, es_sel2.
  - match goal with IH : inert _ -> forall _, trm_var _ = _ -> _ |- _ =>
      destruct (variable_shape_member ltac:(assumption) (IH ltac:(assumption) _ eq_refl))
        as [V [Hv [Hs Ht]]]
    end.
    eauto using es_trans, es_sel1.
  - eauto using es_all.
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_variable_shape : forall G x T,
  inert G -> G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T -> variable_shape G x T.
Proof. intros; eapply (proj1 exact_typing); eauto. Qed.

Local Lemma exact_sub_observe : forall G x S T,
  inert G -> exact_sub G S T -> forall B, observe G x T B ->

Local Lemma heap_entry : forall G Sigma x B,
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> binds x B G ->
  (exists l, binds x (item_lit l) Sigma /\\ G ⊢ l ∶ B) \\/
  (exists R hds, B = typ_bnd R /\\ binds x (item_obj R hds) Sigma /\\
    G ⊢ hds ∶ open x R).
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x B [_ H] Hb.
  specialize (H x (get_some_inv Hb)). inversion H; subst;
    match goal with H' : binds x ?C G |- _ =>
      assert (B = C) by (eapply binds_functional; [exact Hb | exact H']); subst
    end; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma canonical_function : forall G Sigma x S T,
  inert G -> heap_correspond G Sigma ->
  G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_all S T ->
  exists S0 T0 t, binds x (item_lit (lit_fun S0 t)) Sigma /\\
    G ⊢ lit_fun S0 t ∶ typ_all S0 T0 /\\ function_flow G S0 T0 S T.
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x S T Hi Hheap Hty.
  destruct (typed_variable_shape Hi Hty) as [B [Hb H]].
  destruct (H _ (observe_atom x (head_all G S T) (obs_all S T))) as [C [Hc Hf]].
  inversion Hc; subst; simpl in Hf; try (destruct D; discriminate); try discriminate.
  destruct (heap_entry Hheap Hb) as [[l [Hl Htyl]] | [? [? [E _]]]]; try discriminate.
  inversion Htyl; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Local Definition term_typing_head (G : ctx) (t : trm) (U : typ) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | trm_var (avar_f x) => G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ U
  | trm_sel (avar_f x) a => exists S T,
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) /\\ G ⊢ T <: U
  | trm_asn (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) => exists S T,
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ typ_rcd (dec_trm a S T) /\\
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f y) ∶ S /\\ G ⊢ T <: U
  | trm_app (avar_f f) (avar_f a) => exists S T,
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f f) ∶ typ_all S T /\\ G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f a) ∶ S /\\
      G ⊢ open a T <: U
  | trm_new (avar_f c) avs => exists xs Ts is' T,
      G ⊢ trm_var (avar_f c) ∶ typ_con Ts is' T /\\ G ⊢ avs :: Ts /\\
      vars_of_avars xs avs /\\ G ⊢ typ_bnd (open_rec_vars 1 xs T) <: U
  | trm_let S t u => exists L T,
      G ⊢ t ∶ S /\\ (forall x, x \\notin L -> G & x ~ S ⊢ open x u ∶ T) /\\ G ⊢ T <: U
  | trm_lit S l u => exists L T,
      G ⊢ l ∶ S /\\ (forall x, x \\notin L -> G & x ~ S ⊢ open x u ∶ T) /\\ G ⊢ T <: U
  | _ => False
  end.

Local Lemma invert_term_typing : forall G t U, G ⊢ t ∶ U -> term_typing_head G t U.
Proof.
  intros G t U H. induction H; simpl; try solve
    [eauto 8 using ty_var, ty_rec_intro, ty_rec_elim, ty_and_intro, subtyp_refl].
  destruct t; repeat match goal with a : avar |- _ => destruct a end;
    simpl in *; try contradiction; try solve [eauto using ty_sub];
    repeat match goal with H : exists _, _ |- _ => destruct H end;
    repeat match goal with H : _ /\\ _ |- _ => destruct H end;
    eauto 10 using subtyp_trans.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros G D E Es t s Sigma T Hc.
  inversion Hc as [G0 D0 Sigma0 E0 Et Fs t0 T0 i U e' e et

  pose proof (invert_term_typing Hty) as Hhead.

  - destruct s as [|[] s].

  - destruct Hhead as [S [V [Hfield _]]].
    destruct (canonical_field Hi Hheap Hfield) as [R [hds [W [o [Hb [_ [_ [Hhas _]]]]]]]].

  - destruct Hhead as [S [V [Hfun _]]].

    right. eauto using red_app.
  - right. eauto using red_let_sta.
  - destruct (var_fresh (dom Sigma)) as [x Hx].
    right. eauto using red_let_lit.
  - destruct Hhead as [S [V [Hfield _]]].
    destruct (canonical_field Hi Hheap Hfield) as [R [hds [W [o [Hb [_ [_ [Hhas _]]]]]]]].
    destruct (heap_can_update v0 Hb Hhas) as [Sigma' Hup].
    right. eauto using red_asn.
  - destruct Hhead as [xs [Ts [is' [R [Hcon [Has [Hxs _]]]]]]].
    destruct (canonical_constructor Hi Hheap Hcon) as [ds [body [Hb _]]].
    destruct (var_fresh (dom Sigma \\u fv (open_rec_vars 1 xs ds))) as [x Hx].
    apply notin_union in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hfresh Hfv].
    right. eauto 10 using red_new, typed_args_length.

(* Renaming free variables also handles substitution of already evaluated
   arguments. Bound indices stay in place, so renaming commutes with opening. *)
Local Definition rename_avar (r : var -> var) (a : avar) :=
  match a with avar_b i => avar_b i | avar_f x => avar_f (r x) end.

Fixpoint rename_typ (r : var -> var) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (rename_dec r D)
  | typ_and S T => typ_and (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_sel a A => typ_sel (rename_avar r a) A
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_all S T => typ_all (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_con Ts is' T => typ_con (rename_typs r Ts) is' (rename_typ r T)
  end
with rename_typs (r : var -> var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts => typs_cons (rename_typ r T) (rename_typs r Ts)
  end
with rename_dec (r : var -> var) (D : dec) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ A S T => dec_typ A (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | dec_trm a S T => dec_trm a (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  end.

Local Definition rename_def r (d : def) :=
  match d with def_typ A T => def_typ A (rename_typ r T) | def_trm a => def_trm a end.

Fixpoint rename_trm (r : var -> var) (t : trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a => trm_var (rename_avar r a)
  | trm_sel a f => trm_sel (rename_avar r a) f
  | trm_app a b => trm_app (rename_avar r a) (rename_avar r b)
  | trm_let T t u => trm_let (rename_typ r T) (rename_trm r t) (rename_trm r u)
  | trm_lit T l t => trm_lit (rename_typ r T) (rename_lit r l) (rename_trm r t)
  | trm_asn a f b => trm_asn (rename_avar r a) f (rename_avar r b)
  | trm_new a avs => trm_new (rename_avar r a) (List.map (rename_avar r) avs)
  end
with rename_lit (r : var -> var) (l : lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (rename_typ r T) (rename_trm r t)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
      lit_con (rename_typs r Ts) is' (rename_typ r T)
        (List.map (rename_def r) ds) (rename_trm r t)
  end.

Local Lemma rename_typs_list : forall r Ts,
  to_list (rename_typs r Ts) = List.map (rename_typ r) (to_list Ts).
Proof. induction Ts; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_typs_length : forall r Ts,
  length_s (rename_typs r Ts) = length_s Ts.
Proof. induction Ts; simpl in *; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_avar_open : forall r a n x,
  rename_avar r (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_avar r a).
Proof. destruct a; intros; simpl; case_if*. Qed.

Local Ltac syntax_rewrites :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : forall _ _, _ = _ |- _ => progress rewrite H
  | H : forall _, _ = _ |- _ => progress rewrite H
  end.

Local Lemma rename_types_open : forall r,
  (forall T n x, rename_typ r (open_rec n x T) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_typ r T)) /\\
  (forall Ts n x, rename_typs r (open_rec n x Ts) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_typs r Ts)) /\\
  (forall D n x, rename_dec r (open_rec n x D) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_dec r D)).
Proof.
  intros r. apply typ_mutind; intros; simpl;
    fold open_rec_typ open_rec_typs open_rec_dec;
    change (open_rec_typ) with (@open_rec typ TypOpenable) in *;
    change (open_rec_typs) with (@open_rec typs TypsOpenable) in *;
    change (open_rec_dec) with (@open_rec dec DecOpenable) in *;
    try rewrite rename_typs_length; try rewrite rename_avar_open;
    syntax_rewrites; reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_list_open : forall A (O : Openable A) (f : A -> A) r,
  (forall a n x, f (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n (r x) (f a)) ->
  forall (xs : list A) n x,
    List.map f (open_rec n x xs) = open_rec n (r x) (List.map f xs).
Proof.
  intros A O f r H xs n x. induction xs; simpl; congruence.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_def_open : forall r d n x,
  rename_def r (open_rec n x d) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_def r d).
Proof. destruct d; intros; simpl; [f_equal; apply (proj1 (rename_types_open r))|reflexivity]. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_terms_open : forall r,
  (forall t n x, rename_trm r (open_rec n x t) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_trm r t)) /\\
  (forall l n x, rename_lit r (open_rec n x l) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_lit r l)).
Proof.
  intros r. destruct (rename_types_open r) as [HT [HTs HD]].
  apply trm_mutind; intros;
    cbn [open_rec TrmOpenable LitOpenable open_rec_trm open_rec_lit rename_trm rename_lit];
    fold open_rec_trm open_rec_lit;
    change open_rec_trm with (@open_rec trm TrmOpenable) in *;
    change open_rec_lit with (@open_rec lit LitOpenable) in *;
    try rewrite rename_typs_length;
    try rewrite "'!rename_avar_open;
    try rewrite (rename_list_open (rename_avar_open r));
    try rewrite (rename_list_open (rename_def_open r));
    syntax_rewrites; reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_open_many : forall A (O : Openable A) (f : A -> A) r,
  (forall a n x, f (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n (r x) (f a)) ->
  forall ys n a, f (open_rec_vars n ys a) =
    open_rec_vars n (List.map r ys) (f a).
Proof.
  intros A O f r H ys. induction ys; intros; simpl; rewrite ?IHys, ?H; reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Definition fixes (r : var -> var) (X : vars) := forall x, x '"\\in X -> r x = x.

Local Lemma fixes_union : forall r X Y, fixes r (X \\u Y) -> fixes r X /\\ fixes r Y.
Proof. unfold fixes. intros; split; intros; apply H; rewrite in_union; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_avar_fixed : forall r a, fixes r (fv a) -> rename_avar r a = a.
Proof.
  intros r [i|x] H; simpl in *; auto. f_equal. apply H, in_singleton_self.
Qed.

Local Ltac solve_fixed :=
  repeat match goal with
  | H : fixes _ (_ \\u _) |- _ => apply fixes_union in H; destruct H
  end;
  f_equal; eauto using rename_avar_fixed.

Local Lemma rename_types_fixed : forall r,
  (forall T, fixes r (fv T) -> rename_typ r T = T) /\\
  (forall Ts, fixes r (fv Ts) -> rename_typs r Ts = Ts) /\\
  (forall D, fixes r (fv D) -> rename_dec r D = D).
Proof. intros. apply typ_mutind; intros; simpl in *; solve_fixed. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_list_fixed : forall A (F : FreeVar A) (f : A -> A) r,
  (forall a, fixes r (fv a) -> f a = a) ->
  forall (xs : list A), fixes r (fv xs) -> List.map f xs = xs.
Proof. intros A F f r H xs; induction xs; intros; simpl in *; solve_fixed. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_def_fixed : forall r d, fixes r (fv d) -> rename_def r d = d.
Proof. destruct d; simpl; intros; f_equal; apply (proj1 (rename_types_fixed r)); assumption. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_terms_fixed : forall r,
  (forall t, fixes r (fv t) -> rename_trm r t = t) /\\
  (forall l, fixes r (fv l) -> rename_lit r l = l).
Proof.
  intros r. destruct (rename_types_fixed r) as [HT [HTs HD]].
  apply trm_mutind; intros; simpl in *; solve_fixed;
    eapply rename_list_fixed; eauto using rename_avar_fixed, rename_def_fixed.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_fresh_identity : forall r L,
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> r x = x) ->
  forall F, all_notin F L -> fixes r F.
Proof. unfold all_notin, fixes. eauto. Qed.

Local Definition isolated (r : var -> var) (L : vars) :=
  forall x, x \\notin L -> r x = x /\\ forall y, r y = x -> y = x.

Local Lemma identity_isolated : isolated id \\{}.
Proof. unfold isolated, id. auto. Qed.

Local Definition typing_map r (G G' : ctx) :=
  forall x T, binds x T G -> G' ⊢ trm_var (avar_f (r x)) ∶ rename_typ r T.

Local Lemma rename_def_label : forall r d, label_of (rename_def r d) = label_of d.
Proof. intros r []; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma map_get_label : forall A B (LA : LabelOf A) (LB : LabelOf B)
  (f : A -> B), (forall a, label_of (f a) = label_of a) ->
  forall l ds, get_labeld l (List.map f ds) = option_map f (get_labeld l ds).
Proof.
  intros A B LA LB f H l ds. induction ds; simpl; auto.
  rewrite H. case_if*.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_defs_typed : forall G (ds : defs) T r G',
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T -> G' ⊢ List.map (rename_def r) ds ∶ rename_typ r T.
Proof.
  intros G ds T r G' H. induction H; simpl.
  - apply ty_defs_one. inversion H; subst; constructor.
  - apply ty_defs_cons; auto.
    + inversion H0; subst; constructor.
    + unfold labels_hasnt in *. rewrite rename_def_label, map_get_label; auto using rename_def_label.
      rewrite H1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma typing_map_push : forall r G G' x T,
  typing_map r G G' ->

Local Definition rename_avar (r : var -> var) (a : avar) :=
  match a with avar_b i => avar_b i | avar_f x => avar_f (r x) end.

Fixpoint rename_typ (r : var -> var) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_bot => typ_bot
  | typ_rcd D => typ_rcd (rename_dec r D)
  | typ_and S T => typ_and (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_sel a A => typ_sel (rename_avar r a) A
  | typ_bnd T => typ_bnd (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_all S T => typ_all (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | typ_con Ts is' T => typ_con (rename_typs r Ts) is' (rename_typ r T)
  end
with rename_typs (r : var -> var) (Ts : typs) : typs :=
  match Ts with
  | typs_nil => typs_nil
  | typs_cons T Ts => typs_cons (rename_typ r T) (rename_typs r Ts)
  end
with rename_dec (r : var -> var) (D : dec) : dec :=
  match D with
  | dec_typ A S T => dec_typ A (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  | dec_trm a S T => dec_trm a (rename_typ r S) (rename_typ r T)
  end.

Local Definition rename_def r (d : def) :=
  match d with def_typ A T => def_typ A (rename_typ r T) | def_trm a => def_trm a end.

Fixpoint rename_trm (r : var -> var) (t : trm) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a => trm_var (rename_avar r a)
  | trm_sel a f => trm_sel (rename_avar r a) f
  | trm_app a b => trm_app (rename_avar r a) (rename_avar r b)
  | trm_let T t u => trm_let (rename_typ r T) (rename_trm r t) (rename_trm r u)
  | trm_lit T l t => trm_lit (rename_typ r T) (rename_lit r l) (rename_trm r t)
  | trm_asn a f b => trm_asn (rename_avar r a) f (rename_avar r b)
  | trm_new a avs => trm_new (rename_avar r a) (List.map (rename_avar r) avs)
  end
with rename_lit (r : var -> var) (l : lit) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (rename_typ r T) (rename_trm r t)
  | lit_con Ts is' T ds t =>
      lit_con (rename_typs r Ts) is' (rename_typ r T)
        (List.map (rename_def r) ds) (rename_trm r t)
  end.

Local Lemma rename_typs_list : forall r Ts,
  to_list (rename_typs r Ts) = List.map (rename_typ r) (to_list Ts).
Proof. induction Ts; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_typs_length : forall r Ts,
  length_s (rename_typs r Ts) = length_s Ts.
Proof. induction Ts; simpl in *; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_avar_open : forall r a n x,
  rename_avar r (open_rec n x a) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_avar r a).
Proof. destruct a; intros; simpl; case_if*. Qed.

Local Ltac syntax_rewrites :=

  | H : forall _ _, _ = _ |- _ => progress rewrite H
  | H : forall _, _ = _ |- _ => progress rewrite H
  end.

Local Lemma rename_types_open : forall r,
  (forall T n x, rename_typ r (open_rec n x T) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_typ r T)) /\\
  (forall Ts n x, rename_typs r (open_rec n x Ts) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_typs r Ts)) /\\
  (forall D n x, rename_dec r (open_rec n x D) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_dec r D)).

    change (open_rec_dec) with (@open_rec dec DecOpenable) in *;

  (forall l n x, rename_lit r (open_rec n x l) = open_rec n (r x) (rename_lit r l)).

Local Lemma fixes_union : forall r X Y, fixes r (X \\u Y) -> fixes r X /\\ fixes r Y.
Proof. unfold fixes. intros; split; intros; apply H; rewrite in_union; auto. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_avar_fixed : forall r a, fixes r (fv a) -> rename_avar r a = a.
Proof.
  intros r [i|x] H; simpl in *; auto. f_equal. apply H, in_singleton_self.
Qed.

  repeat match goal with
  | H : fixes _ (_ \\u _) |- _ => apply fixes_union in H; destruct H
  end;
  f_equal; eauto using rename_avar_fixed.

  (forall D, fixes r (fv D) -> rename_dec r D = D).

cat >>Task.v <<'EOF'
Local Lemma extends_suffix : forall A (E F Q : env A),
  extends E F -> extends (E & Q) (F & Q).
Proof.
  unfold extends. intros A E F Q H x v Hb. apply binds_concat_inv in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [Hb | [Hf Hb]]; eauto using binds_concat_right, binds_concat_left.
Qed.

Local Lemma defs_context : forall G (ds : defs) T,
  G ⊢ ds ∶ T -> forall G', G' ⊢ ds ∶ T.
Proof.
  intros G ds T H. induction H; intros.
  - apply ty_defs_one. inversion H; subst; first [apply ty_def_typ | eapply ty_def_trm; eassumption].
  - apply ty_defs_cons; auto.
    inversion H0; subst; first [apply ty_def_typ | eapply ty_def_trm; eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma weaken_typing :
  (forall G t T, G ⊢ t ∶ T -> forall G', extends G G' -> G' ⊢ t ∶ T) /\\
  (forall G (l : lit) T, G ⊢ l ∶ T -> forall G', extends G G' -> G' ⊢ l ∶ T) /\\
  (forall G S T, G ⊢ S <: T -> forall G', extends G G' -> G' ⊢ S <: T) /\\
  (forall G vs Ts, G ⊢ vs :: Ts -> forall G', extends G G' -> G' ⊢ vs :: Ts).
Proof.
  apply rules_mutind; intros; try solve
    [eauto using ty_var, ty_all_elim, ty_new, ty_rcd_elim, ty_fld_asn,
       ty_rec_intro, ty_rec_elim, ty_and_intro, ty_sub, subtyp_top, subtyp_bot,
       subtyp_refl, subtyp_trans, subtyp_and11, subtyp_and12, subtyp_and2,
       subtyp_fld, subtyp_typ, subtyp_sel1, subtyp_sel2, typ_avars_nil, typ_avars_cons].
  - eapply ty_let with (L:=L); eauto using extends_suffix.
  - eapply ty_llit with (L:=L); eauto using extends_suffix.
  - eapply ty_all_intro with (L:=L); eauto using extends_suffix.
  - eapply ty_con_intro with (L:=L) (T':=T'); eauto using extends_suffix, defs_context.
  - eapply subtyp_all with (L:=L); eauto using extends_suffix.
Qed.

Local Lemma typing_map_suffix : forall r G G' Q,
  typing_map r G G' ->
  (forall x, x \\in dom Q -> r x = x /\\ forall y, r y = x -> y = x) ->
  all_notin (dom Q) (dom G') ->
  typing_map r (G & Q) (G' & EnvOps.map (rename_typ r) Q).
Proof.
  unfold typing_map. intros r G G' Q H Hr Hf y V Hb.
  apply binds_concat_inv in Hb. destruct Hb as [Hb | [Hn Hb]].
  - rewrite (proj1 (Hr _ (get_some_inv Hb))). apply ty_var, binds_concat_right, binds_map.
    exact Hb.
  - eapply (proj1 weaken_typing); [eauto|].
    apply extends_concat_r, disjoint_comm. rewrite dom_map.
    unfold disjoint. exact Hf.
Qed.

Local Lemma typing_map_push : forall r G G' z T,
  typing_map r G G' ->
  r z = z -> (forall y, r y = z -> y = z) -> z # G' ->
  typing_map r (G & z ~ T) (G' & z ~ rename_typ r T).
Proof.
  intros r G G' z T H Hr Hinv Hf.
  rewrite <- map_single. apply typing_map_suffix; auto;
    unfold all_notin; rewrite dom_single; intros x Hx; rewrite in_singleton in Hx;
    subst; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fresh_avoids : forall L n xs,
  fresh L n xs -> all_notin (from_list xs) L.
Proof.
  intros L n xs. revert L n. induction xs as [|x xs IH]; intros L [|n] H;
    unfold all_notin in *; simpl in H; try contradiction.

Proof.

  - apply eff_ignore.
  - apply eff_fld_asn.
  - unfold rename_effects in *. rewrite List.map_app.
    eapply eff_let with (L:=L \\u K); [exact IHeff_trm|].
    intros z Hz. split_fresh. specialize (H1 z ltac:(assumption)).

  - eapply eff_llit with (L:=L \\u K).
    intros z Hz. split_fresh. specialize (H0 z ltac:(assumption)).

Proof.

    apply from_list_iff in Hx; apply List.in_map_iff in Hx; destruct Hx as [y [<- Hy]];

  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma E -> List.In e E -> free_sub_heap e Sigma D.

Local Lemma dom_stack_each : forall E (e : eff_ctx) x,
  List.In e E -> x \\in dom e -> x \\in list_dom_union E.
Proof.
  intros E e x H. induction E as [|e0 E IH]; intros; simpl in *; try contradiction.
  rewrite in_union. destruct H as [-> | H]; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma init_var_free_inv : forall D vs x,
  init_var D vs x free -> x \\in vs /\\ binds x free D.

  inert_inits D ->

  - match goal with Hc : _ ⸴ _ ⊢c trm_asn _ _ _ |- _ => inversion Hc; subst end.

  committed_heap_defs D ds -> forall D', commit_map id D D' -> committed_heap_defs D' ds.

  committed_heap_item G D itm ->
  extends G G' -> commit_map id D D' -> committed_heap_item G' D' itm.

  intros G D itm G' D' H Hg Hd. inversion H; subst;
    eauto using committed_heap_lit, committed_heap_obj, commit_identity_lit, committed_defs_transport.

Local Lemma heap_correspond_push : forall G Sigma x B itm,
  heap_correspond G Sigma -> x # Sigma ->
  (match itm with
   | item_lit l => G & x ~ B ⊢ l ∶ B
   | item_obj R hds => B = typ_bnd R /\\ G & x ~ B ⊢ hds ∶ open x R

  heap_correspond (G & x ~ B) (Sigma & x ~ itm).
Proof.
  intros G Sigma x B itm [Hdom Hheap] Hfresh Hnew.
  assert (Hg : extends G (G & x ~ B)) by (apply extends_push; congruence).
  split; [rewrite "'!dom_push, Hdom; reflexivity|].
  intros z Hz. rewrite dom_push, in_union, in_singleton in Hz.
  destruct (classic (z = x)) as [-> | Hne].
  - destruct itm as [R ds|l].
    + destruct Hnew as [-> Hty]. eapply ty_item_obj_s; eauto using binds_push_eq.
    + eapply ty_item_lit_s; eauto using binds_push_eq.
  - destruct Hz as [Hz | Hz]; try congruence.
    specialize (Hheap _ Hz). inversion Hheap; subst;
      eauto using ty_item_obj_s, ty_item_lit_s, binds_push_neq, heap_defs_weaken,
      (proj1 (proj2 weaken_typing)).
Qed.

  inert_inits D -> (i = free '"\\/ i = committed) -> inert_inits (D & x ~ i).
Proof.
  intros D x i H Hold z j Hb. apply binds_push_inv in Hb.
  destruct Hb as [[-> ->] | [_ Hb]]; auto.

  free_sub_heaps G D Sigma E -> x # Sigma ->
  (i = committed -> committed_heap_item (G & x ~ B) (D & x ~ i) itm) ->
  free_sub_heaps (G & x ~ B) (D & x ~ i) (Sigma & x ~ itm) E.
Proof.
  intros G D Sigma E x B i itm H Hfresh Hnew.
  destruct (committed_heap_of_stack H) as [Hgdom Hdom].
  assert (Hg : extends G (G & x ~ B)) by (apply extends_push; congruence).
  assert (Hd : extends D (D & x ~ i)) by (apply extends_push; congruence).
  assert (Hs : extends Sigma (Sigma & x ~ itm)) by (apply extends_push; assumption).

    split; [rewrite "'!dom_push, HGD; reflexivity|].
    split; [rewrite !dom_push, HDS; reflexivity|].
